observations: Predicted 15. Tap 2 crossed 14 numbers, leaving five composites; tap 3 crossed four, leaving 25; tap 5 crossed one, leaving zero.
Tap 7 explicitly listed 14,21,28 as already crossed; tap 11 likewise 22 and no new removal. Ten prime survivors remained.

Screenshot showed crossed-out grid cells, distinct tested-prime outlines, current 11 selection and zero counter. Reveal retained original prediction and explained any two factors at least six would give at least 36.
